title: Implement CAMA v3 pipeline (SummaC-inspired NLI pair matrix)
description:
Implement the CAMA v3 pipeline per docs/cama_v3_pipeline.md spec. Work items:

1. NEW FILE: cama-v2/cama/matrix.py — NLIPairMatrix class (sentence×memory NLI pair matrix with bi-encoder pre-filter, batch NLI inference, attribution extraction, ghost extraction)
2. NEW FILE: cama-v2/cama/pipeline_v3.py — CAMAv3Pipeline class (build matrix → extract attributions → ghost detection from matrix → staleness from metadata → contradiction detection memory-vs-memory NLI)
3. UPDATE: cama-v2-tests/benchmarks/realworld/runner.py — Add --pipeline v3 option that uses CAMAv3Pipeline
4. UPDATE: cama-v2-tests/benchmarks/synthetic/evaluate.py — Add --pipeline v3 option
5. UPDATE: cama-v2-tests/benchmarks/realworld/evaluate.py — Make evaluate_scenario accept generic pipeline (not just CAMAv2)

CRITICAL NOTES for compatibility:
- TraceResult fields: use ghost_memories (not ghosts), stale_memories (not stale), memories_used, hallucinated_spans=[], hallucination_rate=0.0
- HallucinatedSpan requires: start_char, end_char (not start/end), and token_scores list
- split_sentences() returns list[tuple[str, int, int]] not list[str] — unpack accordingly
- The spec code in the doc has these mismatches — fix them during implementation
- Existing tests in cama-v2/tests/ must still pass
- Python venv at ~/.venvs/cama
closeReason: CAMA v3 pipeline implemented by cama-v3-builder. 2 new files (matrix.py, pipeline_v3.py) and 3 benchmark updates. All 6 compatibility fixes applied. 77 existing tests pass. Lead-verified via code review. Branch: overstory/cama-v3-builder/cortex-c4aa, commit 1dccbe0.

title: Run CAMA v3 benchmarks (real-world + synthetic)
description: 1. Copy 3 benchmark files from worktree cama-v3-builder to main tree (runner.py, evaluate.py x2). 2. Run real-world benchmark with --pipeline v3. 3. Run synthetic benchmark with --pipeline v3 --n 100. Report all scores.

title: Copy benchmark files and run CAMA v3 benchmarks
description:

- /Users/revanshphull/cortex/cama-v2-tests/benchmarks/realworld/scenarios/ -> cama-v2-tests/benchmarks/realworld/scenarios/ (entire directory)
